risk_note: RV2 (identity registration core, BR-ID-04/05, BR-INV-14). Users row with phone cipher and blind index, default nickname/avatar/level, invite and attr codes with bounded retries in savepoints, same-device limit counted against the injected Clock under a per-device transaction advisory lock with the merge-tombstone pair rule, device_registrations.created_at written from the same Clock instant (column grant by migration 0019, B1-02n), phone already held before the limit (phone_taken), read-committed isolation guard, release / level-log / invite-bind / B1-03g ports, structured error fields without message/detail. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
